nodes.title: Direct Lyrics Input (Manual Override)
widgets_values:
[Hook]
I’m slowing it down for the one that I love
Like the earth’s standing still while the stars crash above

[Verse 1]
[Soft piano only] [Intimate vocal]
The clock on the wall is a liar tonight
Spinning too fast while we chase the light
I’m holding your hand like a lifeline in June
The only thing quiet in a world out of tune

[Chorus]
[Chorus | Energy: Maximum] [Explosive vocal delivery] [Full band burst]
Oh, I’m slowing it down for the one that I love!
Like the earth’s standing still while the stars crash above!
It’s a beautiful weight, it’s a terrifying grace
I’m finally home in the light of your grace!
(In your grace)

[Verse 2]
[Drums settle into a driving backbeat]
We used to be shadows just passing through doors
But I’m not a ghost on these hardwood floors
Every bridge that I burned was a lesson I learned
To wait for the peace that I’ve finally earned

[Chorus]
[Chorus | Energy: Maximum] [Anthemic energy]
Oh, I’m slowing it down for the one that I love!
Like the earth’s standing still while the stars crash above!
It’s a beautiful weight, it’s a terrifying grace
I’m finally home in the light of your grace!

[Verse 3]
[Building intensity] [Gritty piano chords]
Don't let the sun rise, don't let it go cold
I’ve found a story that never gets old
The seconds are dripping like honey and wine
I’m finally yours, and I’m glad that you’re mine

[Chorus]
[Chorus | Energy: Maximum] [Maximum intensity] [Hard hitting drums]
Oh, I’m slowing it down for the one that I love!
Like the earth’s standing still while the stars crash above!
It’s a beautiful weight, it’s a terrifying grace
I’m finally home in the light of your grace!

[Outro]
[OUTRO - BIG FINAL HIT + HARD STOP, massive hall reverb tail]
[Instrumental: Final sustained piano note]
Slowing it down...
For the one I love...
[Precision Landing: Instrumental: Single piano chord]
[End]

nodes.title: START HERE — YuE2 Full Song Instructions
widgets_values:
YuE2 Full Song Producer Studio 🎵

Disable Nodes 2 for Fast groups bypasser to work properly

First use only: Missing foundation models (YuE2-3B and YuE2-Vae) download automatically from Hugging Face into ComfyUI/models/yue2 and ComfyUI/models/vae upon first queue. No manual scripts, installations, or file moving needed.

Two Mutually Exclusive Modes (1-Click Switchable)

The workflow features two dedicated LiteGraph groups managed by Fast Groups Bypasser (set to always one active):

  1. Studio & AI Co-Producer Mode (Default Active):
    • The YuE2 Studio & LLM Producer group is Active.
    • The YuE2 Direct Manual Inputs group is Bypassed (disabled).
    • Select a genre preset, vocal profile, and intro style in YuE2 Style and Lyrics Studio.
    • (Optional) Use the YuE2 LLM Co-Producer & Polisher to polish lyrics, generate concepts, or optimize styles using your preferred provider (LM Studio, Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, OpenRouter).
    • The generated style and lyrics pass through the Style & Lyrics Switch / Merger nodes directly into YuE2 Neural Song Generator.
  2. Direct Manual Mode (1-Click Toggle):
    • Click YuE2 Direct Manual Inputs on the Fast Groups Bypasser.
    • The YuE2 Direct Manual Inputs group becomes Active, and the YuE2 Studio & LLM Producer group automatically becomes Bypassed (disabled)!
    • Type or paste your prompt and lyrics directly into the two top boxes (Direct Style Prompt and Direct Lyrics Input).
    • The Style & Lyrics Switch / Merger nodes automatically route the direct manual text to the generator. Zero cable rewiring required!
  3. Bonus — Studio Presets Without LLM (Bypass LLM Only):
    • If you want to use the Style Studio presets/vocals but skip the LLM, leave Studio mode active, select the YuE2 LLM Co-Producer node, and press Ctrl+M to bypass only the LLM. Studio output passes straight through into the switches.

Prompting & Lyrics Guidelines

  • Style Prompt Format: YuE2 style descriptions followed by vocal profile, genre, instruments, and BPM (e.g. English, high emotive male tenor, synth-pop, 808 bass, driving beat, 102 BPM).
  • Custom Style: You can add in " Style of (artist) song (song name) and the LLM will do its best to match style of the performer and song. (must be used in conjunction with Generate Full Song Concept.)
  • Section Tags: Structure lyrics with uppercase section tags: [Verse 1], [Chorus], [Bridge], [Outro], and always end with [End].
  • Vocal Headers: Place vocal taxonomy at the top of the lyrics: e.g. [voice: high male tenor, soaring clarity] [range: C3-C5].

Useful Settings & Optimizations

  • keep_model_loaded: True (default) keeps the model resident in GPU VRAM between runs via an isolated background worker. Repeat generations start instantly without re-loading ~8 GB weights (saves 10–15s per run!). Set to False or run the YuE2 Unload Model node to immediately release all VRAM.
  • ode_steps: Audio synthesis diffusion steps. 32 is studio reference fidelity; 24 is 1.3x faster (~3.5s saved); 16 is ultra-fast draft mode (~2x faster).
  • attention_backend: auto or cudnn utilizes hardware-accelerated Tensor Core SDPA on RTX 40/50 series GPUs (Ada/Blackwell); sage uses SageAttention INT8 QK; sdpa is PyTorch native fallback.
  • cot: Leave at full for standard songs (full Chain-of-Thought musical planning + melody tokens + audio synthesis). Use melody for melody-guided generation or off for direct audio synthesis.
  • memory_budget_gib: 30 is ideal for 32GB+ GPUs; lower to 16–24 on 24GB GPUs if other applications share VRAM.
  • cfg_scale: 1.0 is default. Controls adherence to style conditioning.
  • seed: 0 generates a random seed on each queue. Use the dropdown below it to set randomize, increment, decrement, or fixed.

Audio Output: Plays back directly in the graph via YuE2 Audio Preview & Saver and saves cleanly to ComfyUI/output/YuE2 (MP3 320k, WAV, or FLAC). Hover over any parameter for detailed tooltips.
